events.title: Demo Update 0.2.1
events.summary: This update brings broad display support to the demo, from classic 4:3 and square screens through ultrawide 21:9, plus portrait formats up to 9:21.Added responsive gameplay framing, UI layouts, HUD scaling, menus, loading screens, and title presentation across supported aspect ratios.Added portrait support, including correctly scaled HUD and aim reticle elements.Improved ultrawide support while preserving gameplay balance. events.title: Demo Update 0.1.2

events.title: Redline Protocol Demo Is Live — Play It Now
events.summary: The cranky crow has been busy.The first public demo for Redline Protocol is now live on Steam, and I’m excited to finally put the game in players’ hands.Redline Protocol is a top-down helicopter action game about striking fast, surviving escalating defenses, and dismantling Haven Global’s war machine one operation at a time.
